independence.qualification: The initial working-directory probe disclosed only the repository path. All substantive final evidence was produced from the allowlisted code-only snapshot.

review_cycles.finding: A schema-valid latent_eval.v3 record could retain a real example_id and suite hash while fabricating family, prompt hash, candidate values/order, permutation and gold, allowing false current-evidence admission.
review_cycles.fix: Bind every current record to the canonical behavioral-v3 example before eval-envelope, gate, report or training-selection acceptance.

findings: Checkpoint selection and selected-state proof did not themselves require canonical suite binding for all seven schema-valid mutation classes.
The runtime proof parser could report PROVEN when pytest returned success with required proof cases skipped.
review_cycles.fix: Require canonical suite joins in selection and selected-state paths, and require a complete named proof set with zero skips before runtime PROVEN.
review_cycles.independence_qualification: Discovery cycle only; broad source search exposed narrative files, so this cycle is not used as final independent certification.

attacks.evidence: Fresh deterministic regeneration and independent validation found no direct final-answer field; initial-only input was non-identifying across every family.
Event removal, applicable order perturbation and counterfactual mutation each changed gold at the manifest-defined minimum rate of 1.0.
Gold-position imbalance is at most one per family; all seven schema-valid canonical-suite mutations are rejected by current binding, selector and selected-state paths.
Canonical raw-record validation and bit-exact offline rescore tests agree on scores, ranking, ties, prediction and correctness.
Canonical scorer negative cases fail closed; exact top ties use the preregistered error policy and near ties retain deterministic ordering.
Tampered top-level and nested run identities fail at load and again before compile/expand.
Negative tests cover tokenizer call, encode, decode, batch_decode, chat template, generate and direct lm_head paths; forbidden paths raise.
Unsupported true values are rejected instead of persisted as an implemented mechanism; recurrence semantics explicitly name detached-cache BPTT.
Report, manifest, raw records and actual decoded selected state must share the adapter identity and content hash.
Synthetic pytest success with 16 passed and 9 skipped produces runtime FAILED, PROOF_TESTS_FAILED and NOT_READY; the real proof has 32 passed and zero skipped.
Fifty derived-only historical evals remain IRRECOVERABLE_LEGACY_SCORER and cannot enter current metrics or authorize spend.
Current-evidence eligibility requires behavioral-v3 canonical binding and latent_eval.v3 raw records; legacy salvage is explicitly non-current.

reviewer_verdict: The reviewed code-only snapshot exposes no demonstrated route to a false R1 infrastructure PASS. This verdict does not claim that latent recurrence works; no valid model experiment has been executed.
